# People blocks

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-skill-references.ts from the block manifests. -->

The People blocks of this version of better-supabase, from the block manifests. Install one with `npx better-supabase add <block>`; the docs page of each block has the method signatures. Entity names are the defaults; an app can rename them under `blocks.<name>.names`.

## time-entries

Time entries with one running timer per member and no overlaps, on any record, billable with a rate. Weekly timesheets go through approvals, and a submitted or approved week is locked.

- Title: Time tracking
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/time-entries
- Client: `timeEntriesBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/time-entries`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `approvals`
- Works with: `outbox`, `audit`, `employees`, `approvals`
- Entities: `time_entry`, `timesheet`
- Tables: `time_entries`, `timesheets`
- Permission keys: `time_entries.read`, `time_entries.track`, `time_entries.approve`, `time_entries.manage`
- Events (`TimeEntriesEvents`): `time_entry.archived`, `time_entry.purged`, `time_entry.recorded`, `time_entry.restored`, `time_entry.started`, `time_entry.updated`, `timesheet.approved`, `timesheet.reopened`, `timesheet.submitted`

## hiring

Jobs and applications on a pipeline per job, candidates from config.recordTypes, scorecards per stage, interviews, and hire, reject and withdraw events for the app to act on.

- Title: Hiring
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/hiring
- Client: `hiringBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/hiring`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `subjects`, `pipelines`
- Works with: `outbox`, `automations`, `employees`, `pipelines`
- Entities: `job_opening`, `application`, `interview`
- Tables: `job_openings`, `applications`, `interviews`
- Permission keys: `hiring.read`, `hiring.write`, `hiring.manage`
- Events (`HiringEvents`): `application.created`, `application.hired`, `application.rejected`, `application.retracted`, `interview.scheduled`, `job_opening.closed`, `job_opening.opened`, `scorecard.submitted`

## employees

Employees with or without an account, a manager, team, job title, employment type and status, an org chart, offboarding, and private details and contracts behind employees.view_sensitive. With time-entries, time entries carry the employee_id of their member.

- Title: Employees
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/employees
- Client: `employeesBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/employees`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `outbox`, `relations`, `hiring`, `time-entries`, `approvals`, `teams`
- Entities: `employee`
- Tables: `employees`
- Permission keys: `employees.read`, `employees.write`, `employees.read_sensitive`
- Events (`EmployeesEvents`): `employee.created`, `employee.manager_changed`, `employee.offboarded`, `employee.purged`, `employee.updated`
- Actions: `employees.from_application`

## leave

Leave types, requests that go through approvals, and a balance ledger per member and year with accruals, adjustments and a year-end carryover. With employees, requests carry the employee_id of their member, or belong to an employee with owner "employee". Balances can live in the app's own table of signed amounts instead of the ledger.

- Title: Leave
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/leave
- Client: `leaveBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/leave`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `approvals`, `ledger`
- Works with: `outbox`, `audit`, `employees`, `share-links`, `teams`, `periods`, `approvals`
- Entities: `leave_request`, `leave_type`
- Tables: `leave_requests`, `leave_types`
- Permission keys: `leave.request`, `leave.read`, `leave.approve`, `leave.manage`
- Events (`LeaveEvents`): `leave_balance.adjusted`, `leave_request.approved`, `leave_request.cancelled`, `leave_request.requested`, `leave_request.split`, `leave_request.updated`, `leave_type.archived`, `leave_type.restored`

## enrollments

Programs of steps per organization, and enrollments of a party, a member or any subject in them with step progress and completion. Onboarding checklists run on it.

- Title: Enrollments
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/enrollments
- Client: `enrollmentsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/enrollments`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `outbox`, `audit`
- Entities: `enrollment_program`, `enrollment`
- Tables: `enrollment_programs`, `enrollments`
- Permission keys: `enrollments.read`, `enrollments.enroll`, `enrollments.manage`
- Events (`EnrollmentsEvents`): `enrollment.cancelled`, `enrollment.completed`, `enrollment.created`, `enrollment.paused`, `enrollment.resumed`, `enrollment.step_completed`, `enrollment_program.archived`, `enrollment_program.created`, `enrollment_program.purged`, `enrollment_program.restored`, `enrollment_program.updated`

## qualifications

Qualification types (certifications, licences, skills) with a validity in months and optional evidence, requirements naming who must hold them (a role, a team, a job title, an asset kind, a segment or one holder), holdings of members, companies and assets that expire, a gap report, the holders qualified on a date, expiry notifications, and holdings granted from course certificates.

- Title: Qualifications
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/qualifications
- Client: `qualificationsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/qualifications`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `subjects`
- Works with: `courses`, `employees`, `teams`, `contacts`, `assets`, `segments`, `attachments`, `notifications`, `outbox`, `audit`
- Entities: `qualification`, `qualification_type`, `qualification_requirement`
- Tables: `qualifications`, `qualification_types`, `qualification_requirements`
- Permission keys: `qualifications.read`, `qualifications.grant`, `qualifications.manage`
- Events (`QualificationsEvents`): `qualification.expired`, `qualification.expiry_warned`, `qualification.granted`, `qualification.revoked`, `qualification_type.archived`, `qualification_type.created`, `qualification_type.restored`, `qualification_type.updated`

## shifts

Shift templates that generate shifts on weekdays, shifts planned in draft and published per team and location, assignments checked for overlap, approved leave, required qualifications and rest time, open shift requests, swaps between members, availability, a roster, planned hours against contract hours, and time entries from worked shifts.

- Title: Shifts
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/shifts
- Client: `shiftsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/shifts`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `teams`
- Works with: `employees`, `leave`, `qualifications`, `time-entries`, `assets`, `approvals`, `notifications`, `outbox`, `audit`
- Entities: `shift`, `shift_template`, `shift_assignment`, `shift_swap`, `shift_availability`
- Tables: `shifts`, `shift_templates`, `shift_assignments`, `shift_swaps`, `shift_availability`
- Permission keys: `shifts.read`, `shifts.write`, `shifts.request`, `shifts.manage`
- Events (`ShiftsEvents`): `shift.cancelled`, `shift.created`, `shift.published`, `shift_assignment.created`, `shift_assignment.released`, `shift_swap.decided`, `shift_swap.requested`

## observations

Typed measurements of a record against definitions with a UCUM unit, a code (LOINC for the shipped vital signs) and valid, reference and critical ranges: a computed flag, critical alerts to the record team's leads, amendments and entered-in-error corrections, idempotent device ingest, series and latest values, and observations mapped from form submissions.

- Title: Observations
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/observations
- Client: `observationsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/observations`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `subjects`
- Works with: `forms`, `notifications`, `outbox`, `audit`
- Entities: `observation`, `observation_definition`
- Tables: `observations`, `observation_definitions`
- Permission keys: `observations.read`, `observations.record`, `observations.manage`
- Events (`ObservationsEvents`): `observation.amended`, `observation.critical_recorded`, `observation.error_marked`, `observation.recorded`, `observation_definition.created`, `observation_definition.updated`

## medications

A medication catalog per organization, orders for a record with a dose, route, schedule and an as-needed maximum, orders imported from a pharmacy, planned doses, each dose recorded as given, refused, skipped or missed with a second check for high-risk medication, and a medication chart per record.

- Title: Medications
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/medications
- Client: `medicationsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/medications`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `subjects`
- Works with: `notifications`, `outbox`, `audit`, `cases`, `signatures`, `guests`
- Entities: `medication`, `medication_order`, `medication_administration`
- Tables: `medications`, `medication_orders`, `medication_administrations`
- Permission keys: `medications.read`, `medications.prescribe`, `medications.administer`, `medications.manage`
- Events (`MedicationsEvents`): `medication_administration.missed`, `medication_administration.recorded`, `medication_order.created`, `medication_order.paused`, `medication_order.stopped`, `medication_order.updated`

## care-plans

Care plans per client: problems with codes from your code systems, goals and the actions that reach them, evaluations over time, one active plan per client published as a version, agreement through a signature, and restrictive measures that start only once approved.

- Title: Care plans
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/care-plans
- Client: `carePlansBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/care-plans`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `subjects`
- Works with: `versions`, `signatures`, `approvals`, `tasks`, `guests`, `notifications`, `outbox`, `audit`
- Entities: `care_plan`, `care_plan_problem`, `care_plan_goal`, `care_plan_action`, `care_plan_evaluation`
- Tables: `care_plans`, `care_plan_problems`, `care_plan_goals`, `care_plan_actions`, `care_plan_evaluations`
- Permission keys: `care_plans.read`, `care_plans.write`, `care_plans.evaluate`, `care_plans.publish`, `care_plans.manage`
- Events (`CarePlansEvents`): `care_plan.archived`, `care_plan.created`, `care_plan.published`, `care_plan.restored`, `care_plan.review_date_reached`, `care_plan.updated`, `care_plan_action.ended`, `care_plan_action.review_date_reached`, `care_plan_action.reviewed`, `care_plan_action.started`, `care_plan_evaluation.created`, `care_plan_goal.status_changed`

## payroll-export

Payroll runs that collect the hours worked, the approved leave and optionally the scheduled shifts of a period into lines per person, locked by an export through a versioned PayrollExportFormat port.

- Title: Payroll export
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/payroll-export
- Client: `payrollExportBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/payroll-export`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `time-entries`, `leave`, `shifts`, `employees`, `outbox`, `audit`
- Entities: `payroll_run`, `payroll_line`
- Tables: `payroll_runs`, `payroll_lines`
- Permission keys: `payroll_export.read`, `payroll_export.export`
- Events (`PayrollExportEvents`): `payroll_run.created`, `payroll_run.exported`

## clinical-decision-support

Tenant rules for dose range, duplicate therapy and interactions over a record's medication orders, alerts that members acknowledge or override with a reason, and a decision context for external engines whose alerts are stored the same way.

- Title: Clinical decision support
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/clinical-decision-support
- Client: `clinicalDecisionSupportBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/clinical-decision-support`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `subjects`, `medications`
- Works with: `observations`, `consents`, `care-plans`, `outbox`, `audit`
- Entities: `care_alert`, `care_rule`
- Tables: `care_alerts`, `care_rules`
- Permission keys: `clinical_decision_support.read`, `clinical_decision_support.write`, `clinical_decision_support.manage`
- Events (`ClinicalDecisionSupportEvents`): `care_alert.decided`, `care_alert.raised`, `care_alert.resolved`, `care_rule.archived`, `care_rule.created`, `care_rule.purged`, `care_rule.restored`, `care_rule.updated`

## e-prescribing

Prescriptions over medication orders with the states draft, signed, sent, dispensed and cancelled, a signature only the prescriber can give, and delivery through a PrescriptionGateway port that carries a FHIR R4 MedicationRequest.

- Title: E-prescribing
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/e-prescribing
- Client: `ePrescribingBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/e-prescribing`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `subjects`, `medications`
- Works with: `outbox`, `audit`
- Entities: `prescription`
- Tables: `prescriptions`
- Permission keys: `e_prescribing.read`, `e_prescribing.write`, `e_prescribing.sign`, `e_prescribing.manage`
- Events (`EPrescribingEvents`): `prescription.cancelled`, `prescription.created`, `prescription.delivery_failed`, `prescription.dispensed`, `prescription.sent`, `prescription.signed`
